label: v0.3.0 — Nomination tracker + thread-view bid history + War Room polish
description: War Room refines the per-card cap warnings (cap-floor advisory rolled up into a single league-wide banner), adds a Nomination Cadence card per franchise (ERA + FA Auction), and the Bid History tab switches to a lot-grouped thread view with expandable bid sequences. New worker endpoint /api/auction/nomination-status powers the cadence tracker.
